name: matthummel/release-banner
title: WordPress release banner
description: A slim countdown bar to the next WordPress release. Place it anywhere; it hides itself after release day.

ctaUrl.label: Button link
ctaUrl.help: #mhrw-features jumps to the feature list on this page. Use a full URL on other pages, e.g. /wordpress-release-watch/#mhrw-features.

dismissible.label: Let visitors close it
dismissible.help: Closing hides it until the next release.
